data.name: [UNVRS]

events.name: Jamie Jones presents Paradise: Starship Eden
Armin van Buuren presents A State of Trance

data.description:
[UNVRS] Information

[UNVRS] (pronounced "Universe") is the world's first hyperclub, opened in 2025 and located in San Rafael, Ibiza. A new category of nightlife experience built for the next generation of club culture, it is the official DJ Mag #1 Club in the World 2026 - making history as the first venue to top the poll in its debut year. Weekly 2026 DJ residencies include Anyma Presents ÆDEN, Armin van Buuren Presents A State Of Trance (ASOT), Carl Cox, David Guetta Presents Galactic Circus, elrow, FISHER, Jamie Jones Presents Paradise, John Summit Presents Experts Only and Tiësto. The venue features three interconnected rooms with arena-scale production and festival-level sound, light and visual systems. Each night is a unique production created exclusively for [UNVRS], combining the scale of an arena with the high-end service of a luxury nightclub. Founded by Yann Pissenem, Owner, Founder & CEO of The Night League and Ushuaïa Entertainment, Ushuaïa Ibiza and Hï Ibiza, [UNVRS] runs from May - October each year. [UNVRS] defines a new standard for nightlife.

data.description:
Ushuaïa Ibiza information

Ushuaïa Ibiza has been the destination of choice for international thrill-seekers arriving on the island since opening in 2011. Hosting the biggest superstar DJs in the world, Ushuaïa Ibiza's iconic stage, large pool area, and open-air dancefloor guarantee an unmatched musical experience pairing incredible production with immersive performances to create truly unforgettable moments.


The first entirely open-air venue, Ushuaïa Ibiza changed the clubbing landscape on the island. With a focus on daytime parties starting in the afternoon, it’s a genuinely life-changing experience listening to your favourite artists, while the sun sets and planes are swooping down over the Ushuaïa Ibiza stage as they land at Ibiza airport.


Dedicated to providing the best outdoor entertainment possible, each summer the venue features an impeccable lineup of superstar resident DJs and the world’s leading club brands from across the electronic music spectrum including David Guetta, Martin Garrix, Calvin Harris, Tomorrowland, ANTSand many more.


The dancefloor stretches from the stage to the pool, with a luxurious VIP area to the right. Towards the back, you’ll find The Cloud, a raised terrace with breathtaking views of the show.


A gateway to a hedonistic wonderland where guests can escape the ordinary and immerse themselves in residencies and guest appearances from the very best in global talent. The venue transports guests to a world beyond imagination, a dance music utopia, where lifelong memories are made.

data.description:
Hï Ibiza information

Opened in 2017 and voted Four-time #1 Club in the World by DJ Mag (2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025), Hï Ibiza is a multi-award-winning nightlife institution located in Platja d'en Bossa, Ibiza. Precision-engineered to push the boundaries of modern clubbing, it connects cultures through diverse music programming and curated art residencies. 2026 residents include Andrea Oliva Presents All I Need, Argy & ARTBAT, Black Coffee, CAMELPHAT Present Summer of Love, Dom Dolla, East End Dubs Presents Eastenderz, Ewan McVicar Presents Club Knuckles, Francis Mercier Presents Solèy, HUGEL Presents Make The Girls Dance, Indira Paganotto Presents ARTCORE, Jonas Blue Presents SENSES, Maz and Antdot Present Dawn Patrol, MEDUZA & James Hype Present OUR HOUSE, MESTIZA, Miss Monique, OFFWEEK, Paco Osuna Presents NOW HERE and Skepta Presents Más Tiempo. Featuring two rooms of headline DJs, a wildcard third dancefloor, breathtaking outdoor terraces, and a first-of-its-kind in-club art gallery. Founded by Yann Pissenem, Owner, Founder & CEO of The Night League and Ushuaïa Entertainment, Ushuaïa Ibiza and [UNVRS], Hï Ibiza runs from May - October each year. This is the world's best multi-room club experience.

Hï Ibiza is comprised of 3 main rooms:


The Theatre: Inspired by classic Italian amphitheatre design, the dancefloor is surrounded by a raised terrace hosting the VIP area. All aspects of this room have been carefully considered to ensure a close connection between the artist and the audience. Each residency is tailored to have a bespoke look and feel, guaranteeing that no two nights are ever the same and the never-before-seen audiovisual production will impress you.

The Club: The underground vibe of the Club Room offers guests a more intimate feel, with a low ceiling boasting incredible lighting installations bathing the darkened room in technicoloured beams of light. With the DJ booth at eye-level clubbers can feel a deeper connection with the artist in an intimate setting.

Wild Corner:Experience the world’s most infamous bathroom: "The Wild Corner." This clandestine spot is where the unexpected comes to life, with impromptu performances by renowned artists. Witnessing The Wild Corner firsthand is an absolute must to grasp its sheer extravagance.


Along with the main rooms, Hï Ibiza has two external areas to relax and socialize. Look out for the secret party at The Wild Corner, the world’s most infamous bathroom.

data.name: Playa Soleil
data.description:
Information about Playa Soleil Ibiza


Playa Soleil is much more than just a beach club; it’s a unique concept that merges music, art, gastronomy, and wellness in the iconic setting of Playa d’en Bossa, Ibiza. Created by the visionaries behind Ushuaïa and Hï Ibiza, this space redefines bohemian luxury with a design inspired by natural and organic materials, offering a relaxed and sophisticated atmosphere.




Music is the soul of Playa Soleil, with performances by renowned international DJs in its indoor club, Maison Musique. Additionally, quieter days are accompanied by soothing melodies that enhance the gastronomic experience.




With its focus on sustainability, boho-chic style, and exceptional service, Playa Soleil invites its visitors to experience the magic of Ibiza from a unique perspective.

data.name: O Beach Ibiza
data.description:
Information about O Beach Ibiza

O Beach Ibiza, previously known as Ocean Beach, is the trendy beach club in San Antonio, hosting some of the most famous pool parties in Ibiza.



Opened in 2012, O Beach Club combines the concept of a glamorous beach club with one of the best sunsets in the Mediterranean. Located just a few meters from the sea, its terrace is the perfect spot to enjoy fun pool parties, featuring a spectacular central pool of 600 square meters, surrounded by numerous sunbeds and VIP tables.



O Beach Club brings an excellent music selection with top DJs. The venue opens at midday with a relaxed vibe, gradually building up as the sun sets, with the party lasting until midnight.



2018 was undoubtedly its breakthrough year, attracting major promoters to host their pool parties at O Beach. Since then, it has maintained top residencies and regularly sells out every day.



Grab your swimsuit and sunglasses, and don’t miss out!



What will you find at O Beach Club Ibiza?

Acrobatics, live performances, and, of course, an unmatched atmosphere that takes you far from your daily routine. Simply let go and follow your instincts—dance to the rhythm of the music or relax on your VIP bed while sipping the most sophisticated cocktails.



Additionally, O Beach offers a variety of glamorous services for a true luxury experience: exquisite fusion cuisine at its restaurant, an exclusive boutique, and, of course, VIP areas to enjoy an unforgettable day.

data.name: Bambuku Ibiza
data.description:
Discover Bam-Bu-Ku Ibiza


Bam-Bu-Ku Ibiza is a tropical paradise that blends relaxation, gastronomy, music, and entertainment in a spectacular setting. Located in the bay of San Antonio, right next to its sister venue, O Beach, it offers a unique experience for families, couples, and groups of friends of all ages.




One of its main attractions is Ibiza’s only artificial wave, Flowrider, where guests can learn to surf or bodyboard with the help of expert instructors. The club also features an impressive lagoon-style pool surrounded by Balinese beds and sun loungers, perfect for enjoying the Mediterranean sun.




Bam-Bu-Ku’s restaurant blends tropical and Mediterranean flavors, serving fresh and delicious dishes ideal for any time of day. All this is complemented by a varied cocktail menu that perfectly matches the sea views.




Finally, the club also stands out for its diverse events calendar designed for all audiences. From the Summerrockz Pool Party to the Ibiza Brunch Club—an exclusive brunch with live music—to themed parties like El Kiddo, created especially for families, Bam-Bu-Ku offers a unique experience every day of the week.




If you're looking for an unforgettable experience that combines fun, exclusivity, and the true spirit of Ibiza, Bam-Bu-Ku is your ideal destination.

data.name: Chinois Ibiza

events.name: Major League DJz Presents Echoes of Tomorrow

data.description:
Information about Chinois Ibiza

Located in the former HEART Ibiza venue and inspired by the decadent yet wicked jazz clubs of 1930s Shanghai, Chinois promises to offer old-world hospitality while immersing guests in world-class contemporary entertainment on the sunny shores of Ibiza.


This 3,000-square-meter venue, set to be the island's most anticipated opening, has been meticulously designed by the award-winning Parisian design studio Laleh Assefi. The interiors, bold yet elegant, celebrate the era of Chinoiserie in every tile and table, echoing a time of past grace and charm.


The grand and sumptuous palette is designed to be a sensory feast, and behind its opulent mix of East and West, there is a sense of wit and playfulness, an undeniable tribute to Ibiza’s sacred hedonistic heritage.


Chinois will host international talents, from acclaimed resident DJs to headline superstars and artists, providing an immersive experience to partygoers with the highest production standards.

data.name: Ibiza Rocks
data.description:
Ibiza Rocks Hotel information

Ibiza Rocks Hotel is an iconic venue in San Antonio, famous for hosting some of the most legendary pool parties on the island. Over the years, Ibiza Rocks has established itself as a key reference point for live music events and daytime parties in Ibiza, particularly popular with the British crowd.




Ibiza Rocks was born in 2005 from the ambitious idea of bringing live rock music to the island. It initially launched as a concert venue, welcoming some of the biggest international bands to perform on its impressive open-air terrace. Artists such as The Prodigy, Madness, The Libertines, Fatboy Slim, Kasabian and Dizzee Rascal have all taken to the Ibiza Rocks stage over the years.




In more recent seasons, Ibiza Rocks Hotel made a strategic shift away from live concerts to focus exclusively on its now world-famous pool parties. This change proved to be a huge success. Recent seasons have featured an outstanding event calendar, including Craig David’s TS5 residency — which sold out week after week — as well as explosive performances from acts like Rudimental.




All Ibiza Rocks Hotel events take place in the venue’s central courtyard. The swimming pool is the heart of the space and has been the scene of countless unforgettable moments, often becoming the target of spontaneous dives by both artists and party-goers alike.




In 2018, the venue underwent a major refurbishment, introducing a new space designed for 360-degree performances, enhanced VIP areas including exclusive party suites, upgraded bars with faster service, and a powerful new VOID sound system to elevate the overall experience.




In 2026, Ibiza Rocks takes its concept even further, evolving into Ibiza Rocks Pool Club. The venue expands its daytime offering to become the perfect place to spend long summer days with friends, combining music, sunshine, poolside vibes and the unmistakable energy of Ibiza — a social hub where the island’s lifestyle truly comes to life.

data.name: Eden Ibiza

events.name: Markus Schulz presents Open To Close

data.description:
Eden Ibiza nightclub information

Eden Ibiza is one of the main promoters of San Antonio’s nightlife,a key venue in the clubber history of Ibiza, protagonist of the best night os electronics


Previously known as the Star Club or Kaos, Ibiza stalwarts Pete Tong and Judge Jules are remembered for traditionally holding residencies at the venue before it finally became Eden in 1999.

After a recent refurbishment Eden Ibiza has really come in to its own holding popular residences such as Defected in the House.With a decoration that evokes to the Garden of Eden, the club returns with a new philosophy and another mentality, which is relaunch San Antonio nights.


With cheaper entry and reasonable drinks prices, Eden is a fantastic venue to enjoy deep house and techno on a superclub scale. Located a mere stones throw away from where many party goers and seasonal workers are homed, Eden can guarantee a crowd of familiar faces and a great place to boogie with newfound friends.


Eden nightclub counts on Incubus Gold of Void, a sound system exclusive in Ibiza that could be enjoyed by a crowd of 3000 people. It is divided into a large and sophisticated main room and a second room with independent access. Eden Ibiza also has two cabins, several bars and two VIP areas with private parking.

data.name: Es Paradis

events.name: Don't Tell Mama by Pedro Cazanova

data.description:
Information about Es Paradis Ibiza

Es Paradis club, situated on the seafront in San Antonio, is undoubtedly one of the most beautiful clubs in the Mediterranean.




Es Paradis Ibiza opened in 1975 and was created by the artist Lluís Güell, also the creator of Café del Mar




It is built on a huge glass pyramid. Its interior is a spectacular space where the predominant color is the purest white decorated with the most exotic and varied vegetation.


In the hottest suimmer nights, Es paradis can open its roof




The club has two floors with two different rooms, decorated in true Roman style, with columns, palm trees and luxurious marble, predominantly white and very common in Ibiza. It's an icon of the nights in Ibiza and one of those nightclubs that you must visit at least once in your life.




Located in San Antonio, Es Paradis nightclub is focused on a British public, but it is also common to see many residents of the island.




Its most famous and fun party is the Water Party, where water jets are the stars and the dance floor is flooded for everyone to enjoy. In addition, Es Paradis Club presents an extensive calendar of parties and unique experiences every summer




Es Paradis has a wide and diverse offer, three dance floors with three different environments: Café Paradis, The Gallery and the Main Hall. Also it has multiple services: 10 bars, wardrobe, a boutique and four VIP areas

data.name: 528 Ibiza
data.description:
Located between the picturesque hills of Benimussa, in the middle of virgin farmland, lemon orchards, and with elevated views towards the famous sunset in the distance, 528 Ibiza is an impressive blank canvas that invites projecting something magical onto it.



The venue (formerly Benimussa Park) is the perfect setting for the island's most exclusive events, accessible only to a few privileged individuals. It consists of 3 distinct areas:


- Garden: The outdoor area that features bars, gardens, as well as its renowned amphitheater where parties take place.

- Terrace: The ideal place to relax, recharge, and continue the party.

- Theater: The indoor area, renovated in 2021, where private events and gala dinners are held.

data.name: SWAG
data.description:
SWAG Ibiza club information

SWAG Ibiza club, in the center of Playa d'en Bossa,is the urban club number 1 in the island.


The club SWAG opened its doors for the first time back in 2014 to consolidate as the main alternative in Ibiza offering the best urban music in the island. A place to visit if you are looking for something different. In a few years it has become the hot spot for anyone who wants to escape electronic music and enjoy an alternative night.


Open 7 days a week, we can find in SWAG club a mix of several music styles and all kinds of Urban music:, Live concerts, Hip Hop, R&B, Rap, Trap but also latin beats like Reggaeton... are the genres that you will be able to dance depending on the night event. A perfect combination with the only objective of make the public enjoy a different night experience in Ibiza.


SWAG parties do not lack international DJs that set trends in urban culture.


SWAG nightclub, with a capacity for 1.000 people, has two rooms, 3 exclusive VIP area, a DJ booth that can house two artists at the same time for B2B sessions.. and in addition an impressive lighting and visual system.

data.name: Lío
data.description:
Information about Lío Ibiza

Lío Ibiza is not a restaurant, nor a club, nor a cabaret—it's all of them at once! A 360º experience.

Lío Club Ibiza is a complete experience, and it’s no coincidence that this restaurant-cabaret has become one of the most exclusive places in the world.

Since its opening, it has become a must-see in the island's nightlife. Lío is the place for beautiful, sophisticated people, full of VIPs and celebrities. It is a meeting point for actors, singers, and athletes; stars like Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, and Michael Jordan have visited.



At Lío Ibiza, you’ll find:



A delicious and selective gastronomic offer to enjoy dinner


Amazing cabaret shows, acrobatics, and musical performances... with the particularity that the audience is in constant interaction with the artists


Unique views of Dalt Vila from its prime position on the waterfront


And of course, some of the most fun parties in Ibiza until dawn.


Lío Club Ibiza has luxurious facilities, decorated with notable good taste. It also has a pool inside. Whether for drinks or to dine and enjoy the full show, Lío Ibiza is a unique place you must experience.



The nightclub at Lío Ibiza

Parties at Lío nightclub usually start at 1 AM. In the past season, we found parties with DJ Sebastián Gamboa, his Vintage party, and other events with famous DJs like 2ManyDJs, Felix Da Housecat, Idris Elba, Cathy Guetta... A fun offering for every night of the summer.

data.name: Teatro Pereyra

events.name: Le Baile Pop by Keep On Dancing

data.description:
Information about Teatro Pereyra

The Teatro Pereyra (also known as Teatro Pereira), located in the heart of Ibiza, is an iconic historic theater that, after years of closure, has been meticulously restored to regain its former glory. Its architecture, which preserves classical elements with contemporary touches, creates a cozy and elegant atmosphere, ideal for enjoying an unprecedented musical performance on the island.


In addition to its exceptional musical programming, Teatro Pereyra stands out for its gastronomic offerings, which include a selection of gourmet dishes inspired by Mediterranean cuisine with a modern twist. Visitors can indulge in exquisite culinary options during performances, in a dedicated space that combines culinary art with the elegance of theater.


The entertainment continues beyond the musical and dinner, as the theater transforms into a vibrant social space where the audience can enjoy handcrafted cocktails and more music until dawn, providing the perfect environment to socialize and enjoy the Ibizan nightlife. Teatro Pereyra, with its innovative approach to combining musical entertainment, high-level gastronomy, and socializing, becomes a must-visit destination for culture and leisure lovers in Ibiza.

data.name: Baloo Ibiza
data.description:
Baloo: The Luxury Jungle of Playa d'en Bossa

Step into Baloo, a wild oasis in the heart of Playa d'en Bossa that combines gastronomy with the best themed events for all tastes.

Baloo Ibiza is made up of 2 distinct spaces:

Terrace

The Terrace is undoubtedly the nerve center of the venue, ideal for enjoying a refreshing cocktail while dancing to the latest hits from the resident DJ. It is full of vegetation, making you feel like you are in a real jungle.

Magic Room

The party comes to life as the night progresses, the Magic Room invites you to unleash your wild spirit. From 11:00 PM to 5:00 AM, this indoor space welcomes attendees with a mix of Latin rhythms, reggaeton, afrohouse, house, and showcases until dawn.

Don't be left out and buy tickets for Baloo Ibiza, the trendy spot in Playa d'en Bossa.

data.name: Ibiza Cruise Crush
data.description:
Ibiza Cruise Crush

Ibiza Cruise Crush is one of the most popular boat parties on the island, specially designed for those looking for a unique experience that combines music, fun, and the vibrant Ibiza atmosphere.



This boat party, which sets sail from the port of Figueretas several days a week (depending on the season), offers a 3-hour experience of music, dancing, and fun on the Mediterranean Sea.


Guests enjoy an open bar with beer, sangria, and soft drinks, while dancing to live music that ranges from commercial hits to R&B and reggaeton.


There is also a swimming stop in the crystal-clear waters of Ibiza.



The party includes a 2-hour pre-cruise brunch by the pool at Hotel Vibra Mare Nostrum, with two free drinks and an all-you-can-eat buffet.



Tickets are available from €80, with VIP options that include private beds, full open bar, and priority boarding.



Cruise Crush is the perfect choice for those looking for a lively party, meeting new people, and enjoying the true spirit of Ibiza from the sea. With a relaxed and fun atmosphere, it's ideal for groups of friends, singles, and couples alike.

(function(){
function recalc(){
const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');
if(icons.length < 2) { line.style.height = '0px'; return; }

const first = icons[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y1 = (first.top - box.top) + first.height/2;
const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(recalc, 0), { once:true });
window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);
document.querySelectorAll('.detalles').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', recalc));
const listEl = document.getElementById('itList');
if(listEl) new MutationObserver(recalc).observe(listEl, {subtree:true, childList:true});
})();
